text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, that was so cool!
So that was the 'Kongo Yaegaki Style'!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Believing classical martial arts also translate to racing,
I make honing my martial skills a daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Your incredible core strength comes from your martial arts, right, Yaeno-san? Maybe I should try it too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your father was a sumo wrestler, wasn't he, Chiyono O-san?
Did you ever train together with him?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It was back when I was a kid, but I did learn how to do shiko stomps, teppo thrusts, sliding steps, and the splits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I think that's an extremely valuable experience.
You get to see the proper form countless times, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, I recommend you try
those out first.
I believe your level of understanding will be completely different.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understanding... The sight of my father training
is certainly burned into my memory!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll give it a shot right away!
Maybe now I'll understand important things
I didn't notice back when I was a kid!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By incorporating sumo wrestler practice into her training from that day on,
Sakura Chiyono O gained all kinds of new insights.
